annotations.title: Resolve an identifier to a provider

description: Resolve ANY identifier — website URL, domain (stripe.com), or GitHub org (github.com/stripe) — to the apis.io provider it belongs to. Use this when you have a URL, not a slug. Understanding plan. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

name: resolve
